title: Execution, Validation, Scheduler, Test, and RUN Truth whole-scope fixed-point audit
base_requirement: Apply on top of the current tree where REMED-R02A v2 and REMED-R02B v2 are already present.
audit_conclusion: R02A v2 plus R02B v2 are valid as the R02 implementation window, but R02 must not be represented as a final whole-scope closure. Several findings remain partial/deferred and are explicitly exported to later remediation overlays or G3R gates.

production_truth_checked.scheduler_boundary: Normal run_specs ingress consults execution_scheduler_truth before process spawn and no longer accepts exec_scheduler_enabled=false as a bypass.
production_truth_checked.reuse_history_authority: Reuse decisions are rebuilt from EXO/RUN execution history rather than projection-only reuse-index files.
production_truth_checked.materialize_boundary: MATERIALIZE verifies file:...#sha256 refs before restoring output bytes and skips process spawn only for authoritative decisions.
production_truth_checked.validation_state: Validation state/events are projection-marked and attempts no longer persist replayable argv, but validation resume/progress/control state is still compatibility state and remains partial for EXEC-A01/A02.
production_truth_checked.test_receipts: Test run projections point at canonical RUN-V3 TestRunReceipts with digest checks; direct run_specs binds receipts to event_run_id.
production_truth_checked.failed_history_selection: Failed-test selection prefers the latest valid canonical receipt and a clean receipt suppresses stale projection failures.
production_truth_checked.android_count_truth: Android setup/readiness/zero-test failures do not fabricate testcase failures, but broader Android TestResult/evidence taxonomy remains partial/exported.

corrected_false_implication.old_problem: The folded H01 hotfix listed EXEC-A01 and EXEC-A02 under fixed_findings even though the same disposition correctly kept them partial.
corrected_false_implication.new_disposition: H01 fixed TEST-A09/TEST-A13 production gaps and only touched EXEC-A01/EXEC-A02; it did not close those validation-state authority findings.
